critical_code_review_comments: routes/whatsapp_link.py:campaign_compose — cands can be empty (no offers, no gallery, no curated match for business_type). Then pick=None is returned and frontend renders 'image': null; consider always guaranteeing at least the curated fallback (currently 'curated:dining' is only picked when business_type == 'restaurant', so a fresh salon with 0 gallery items and 0 offers gets 4 non-dining curated items — OK, but tighter typing would help).

routes/whatsapp_link.py:campaign_action — POST /campaigns/{cid}/pause on a non-existent campaign silently returns 409 'Campaign already finished' rather than 404. camp.set_status can't distinguish 'no match because unknown id' from 'no match because already terminal'. Consider a 404 + separate 409 to make the API less confusing (frontend currently only surfaces the toast).

routes/tenant_settings.py:get_branding correctly returns reception_phone and manager_phone now (bug fix verified) — but body BrandingIn should also strip whitespace / normalize the phone to a stable format so PUT '+91 98765 11111' + GET returns the same canonical form regardless of how the user typed it.

components/crm/WaCampaignModal.jsx — send() posts image_url as image?.url which is a fully-qualified public URL for gallery/offer items but a relative '/assets/offers/*.jpg' path for the CURATED fallbacks. Backend has the ' if img.startswith("/") ' rewrite, but if the frontend later runs on a different origin the curated relative path could break; consider always resolving to absolute on the server side of compose (already returns c.url as-is).
